name: Banded Cotinga
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia and minas gerais to rio de janeiro)
description: Jaw-droppingly beautiful bird. Males are cobalt-blue and purple, while females are dusky brown above with white scaling and buff below with dark spots.

name: White-spectacled Bulbul
rangeDescription: Coastal southern türkiye to near east, sinai peninsula, and arabia
description: A medium-sized passerine that is conspicuous and noisy. Note the overall gray plumage, black head, and broad black tail.

name: American Herring Gull
rangeDescription: Northern north america (alaska to atlantic coast); winters to central america
description: Common and widespread large gull found throughout North America. Adults have a fairly pale gray back, pale eye, and dull pinkish legs.

name: Williams's Lark
rangeDescription: Black lava desert of northern kenya (marsabit region)
description: A small, compact lark with variable dark- to rusty-brown upperparts, sometimes with darker streaks or feather centers, pale eyebrows and throat, and a pale belly that contrasts with the heavily streaked chest, often washed rufous. The tail is brownish with white outer feathers that are conspicuous in flight.

name: Chestnut-shouldered Goshawk
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern and eastern new guinea
description: A very rare and little known, powerful raptor of foothill and lower montane forest interior. Black crown, dark wings with chestnut edged shoulders, heavily streaked chest and barred belly.

name: Crested Tit-Warbler
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of north-central china to tibet and sichuan
description: Small sublime bird of scrubby alpine and subalpine forests. Male has iridescent blue-green wings, a long silver cap, and rusty cheeks and neck.

name: White-throated Earthcreeper
rangeDescription: West slope of andes of southwestern peru and far northern chile (arica)
description: Fairly common but local in higher foothills of the Andes. Found in scrubby valleys, often in villages and adjacent agricultural terraces.

name: Olive-headed Weaver
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern tanzania, zambia, malawi, and mozambique
description: A localized woodland weaver that has a dusky-olive head and upperparts, and golden-yellow underparts. Brighter male has a golden-yellow crown and more extensive rusty breast patch.

name: Sooty Gull
rangeDescription: Red sea and persian gulf area to southern pakistan and northern kenya
description: Medium-sized elongated gull. Brown-gray overall with a long bill and dark underwings.

name: Red-keeled Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Widespread throughout philippines
description: A small bird of lowland and foothill forest and more open woodland. Black upperparts are glossed blue, while white underparts are washed with pale gray.

name: Red-flanked Bluetail
rangeDescription: Breeds from finland and northern russia eastward to mongolia, northeastern china, korea, and japan; resident in japan (except for hokkaido), otherwise winters to southern china, taiwan, indochina, myanmar, and thailand
description: Beautiful adult male is shimmering sky-blue above and pale below, with orange sides and a small white eyebrow. Female and juvenile are more subdued, but still have the rufous flanks and blue tail.

name: Roviana Rail
rangeDescription: New georgia group (west-central solomon islands)
description: A flightless rail with a plain rufous back and neck, a plain gray throat and narrow eyebrow, a dark bill, and underparts barred brown and white. Seemingly tolerant of a wide variety of habitats, including secondary forest and gardens.

name: Graceful Pitta
rangeDescription: Highlands of sumatra
description: Rare and secretive jewel of the Sumatran highlands. Found at 400-1400 meters in wet forest, especially in gullies and ravines.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Northern Scrub-Robin
rangeDescription: Northern queensland (rainforest of coastal cape york peninsula)
description: Long-legged songbird found in rainforests of the Cape York Peninsula. Brown above, pale gray below, with black-and-white patterned wing and long tail, often flicked upward.
imageCreditName: Doug Herrington || Birdwatching Tropical Australia Tours

name: Buru Boobook
rangeDescription: Buru island (southern moluccas)
description: An atypical-looking and distinctive smallish boobook, with its fairly unmarked bright cinnamon-brown plumage. Endemic to Buru, where it inhabits lowland and foothill forests.

name: Giant Ibis
rangeDescription: Lowlands of thailand, cambodia, laos, and southern vietnam
description: A hulking gray ibis the size of a large goose and with a distinctively long-bodied appearance, this increasingly rare scimitar-billed waterbird is unmistakable in its limited range. Size alone separates this species from other ibises that share its range; also note wrinkly bald head, dark back, and beautifully scalloped wings.

name: Shining Drongo
rangeDescription: Forest of guinea and sierra leone to gabon and eastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A large, extremely glossy square-tailed drongo of forest understory, often found with mixed-species flocks. Habitat is this species’ most reliable field mark, as no other drongos are regularly found in forest understory.

name: Fiscal Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern botswana and south africa; winters to mozambique
description: A large pied flycatcher that is most commonly mistaken for Southern Fiscal. However, the upright stance and slender unhooked bill are distinctive flycatcher traits, and the pattern of white in the flight feathers and basal windows of the tail is diagnostic.

name: Baudin's Black-Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Far southwestern australia (south of the murchison river)
description: Black cockatoo with white ear patch and white tail panel. Inhabits moist eucalypt forest in the southwestern corner of Western Australia, where it eats seeds from large seed pods of Marri and Karri trees.

name: Southern Royal Albatross
rangeDescription: Campbell and auckland islands; ranges circumpolar southern oceans
description: Huge albatross of the Southern Ocean; breeds mainly on Campbell and Auckland Islands in New Zealand, but ranges widely. Easily separated at a distance from smaller albatrosses by white back.
